query: INSERT INTO diaries (owner_user_id, timezone, slot_minutes, lead_minutes, horizon_days, enabled) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) ON CONFLICT (owner_user_id) DO UPDATE SET timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, slot_minutes = EXCLUDED.slot_minutes, lead_minutes = EXCLUDED.lead_minutes, horizon_days = EXCLUDED.horizon_days, enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, updated_at = now()
